name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from too many orders, and keep service going even when the signal is lost. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark the order “Ready” and “Collected”.

■ Don’t promise a time you can’t keep
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s pace.

■ Take orders right at the food truck
Add on-the-spot orders to the same screen that shows pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen (KDS) shows what to make now, what’s next and what’s ready, and gives an alert when an order needs starting.

■ Print order tickets
Connect a kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or over your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

■ Service carries on even when the signal is lost
Switch on offline protection: if the connection is lost, pre-orders stop so nobody can place an order you won’t see. Orders taken on the device are saved and sync when you are back online.

■ Made just for the food truck
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen lit during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan your week
Set up your events and places once, and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
whatsNew:
HatchGrab now supports 60 languages.

As well as over Bluetooth, print order tickets to a kitchen printer on your local network.

Bug fixes and improvements.
shortDescription: Pre-orders for food trucks, collection time and a kitchen screen — in one place.
